1 لَكَزَهُ , aor.
لَكُزَ , (Mgh, Msb,) inf. n. لَكْزٌ, (S, Mgh, Msb, K,) He struck him upon the breast (AO, S, A, Mgh, Msb, K) with the fist: (AO, S, Mgh, Msb:) and upon the حَنَك [or part beneath the chin]: (A, K:) and upon the neck: (K:) or upon any part of the body with the fist: (AZ, S, Msb:) or with the extremities of the fingers: (TA, art. لقز:) he pushed, or impelled, or repelled, him: (TA, ibid.:) he thrust or pierced him [with a spear or the like]: (TA, art. لز:) لَكْزٌ is also syn. with وَكْزٌ [which has several significations, some of which are indentical with some explained above]. (K.) You say also, لَكَزَهُ بِجُمْعِ كَفِّهِ He struck him upon the breast, or the part called حَنَك, with his fist. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
